# The unnamed-object tests find properties by name instead of map order

The new table uses a HashMap with StringProp and NumberProp, then finds each property by name before checking its Rust type. It also checks the top-level body name/count and excludes unnamed output in delta and Other contexts. These assertions establish the intended identities without depending on iteration order. The negative loops do not assert a complete schema shape. The changed media-resource assert has no message; the unnamed-object assertions have expected-behavior messages. Later accepted navigation-property assertions belong to another phase. No test or ordering experiment ran.

Scope: Graph OpenAPI extraction test identity checks.
